Write ctasapp shards to disk

Write_ctasapp.Rd

Writes the frames produced by the 3_reporting workflows into strDir in the layout the ctasapp dashboard reads. The function walks lReporting two levels deep: each top-level element is a reporting-workflow output (a named list of frames) and every data frame it contains is written using its inner name as the file stem. Top-level bare data frames (e.g. Reporting_Metrics) are also written, keyed by the lowercase workflow ID (Reporting_Metrics -> metrics.parquet) so ctasapp picks them up even when the Summary workflow that wraps them is skipped. This handles both the metric side (Reporting_Results = list(results, input, untransformed)) and the queries side (Reporting_Queries = list(queries)) in a single call.

Usage

Write_ctasapp(lReporting, strDir, strFormat = "parquet")

Arguments

lReporting

list Output of workr::RunWorkflows() on the reporting workflows – a named list whose elements are themselves named lists of data frames.

strDir

character Directory to write into. Created if absent.

strFormat

character "parquet" (default) or "csv".

Value

character Paths written, invisibly.

Details

parquet is the default: input grows quickly and Posit Connect deployments of ctasapp read parquet from embedded:. csv is offered because the dashboard's upload tab accepts it and it needs no extra dependency.

Empty frames are skipped (an empty untransformed is normal - only some Input_*() functions record original values). The function errors if lReporting contains no writable frames, so a mis-shaped input never silently produces an empty output directory.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Write_ctasapp(lReporting, tempdir())
} # }
